Find all functions $f:\mathbb{R}\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ such that

$P(x,y): f(x - f(y)) = f(x + y^n) + f(f(y) + y^n)$.

$P(x, 0): f(x - f(0)) = f(x) + f(f(0))$, i.e., $f(x - c) = f(x) + f(c)$.

$f(x - f(y)) - f(x + y^n) = f(f(y) + y^n)$, which is constant in $x$.

$f(x - a) - f(x + b) = f(a + b)$. Let $t = x + b$, so $x = t - b$, $x - a = t - b - a$. Then:
$f(t - a - b) - f(t) = f(a + b)$.

So $f(t - (a+b)) - f(t) = f(a+b)$, i.e., $f(t - s) - f(t) = f(s)$ where $s = a + b = f(y) + y^n$.
